openFindings.title: Pre-dispatch recovery records null consumed approval and falsely labels provider write read-only

locations.reason: recover snapshots stored before coordinator.reconcile; after reconcile reserves/consumes new dispatch, wrapper returns stored.dispatchAttempt?.approvalId from stale snapshot.
Recovery audit unconditionally mode:read-only-reconciliation and passes null approvalId although resumed recovery performs one POST.

reproduction: Create real SQLite durable delivery with immutable baseline and provably no dispatch by denying initial authorisation.
Advance virtual clock beyond lease; call actual Operations.recover with exact server-held payroll approval/deliveryId and no browser digest.
Actual Boundaries+Adapter consume fresh approval, record immutable marker and perform one injected synthetic POST; reconciliation acknowledges.
Database dispatch marker/consumed authority have same nonempty approvalID. Response and staffology-payroll-recovery audit approvalId are null; audit mode is read-only-reconciliation.
openFindings.impact: Payroll provider-write recovery is misrepresented in the durable audit and cannot directly identify its consumed approval from that event, impairing exact recovery/authority proof. Actual row remains fenced and marker retains approval; no duplicate or unauthorized POST demonstrated.
openFindings.boundedRepair: Reread actual final dispatch marker/approval after recovery and propagate it into response/audit. Classify recovery from actual recorded facts so a resumed dispatch is distinguishable from readback-only reconciliation. Keep exact scope, current principal, one-shot approval, baseline and ownership guards.
requiredHeldOutPass: Recovery audit/response approvalId equals actual newly consumed dispatch marker.
Resumed dispatch recovery is not labelled read-only; existing uncertain dispatch readback does not POST and retains original approval identity.

priorFindingDispositions.evidence: Unchanged provider baseline resumes after expiration while retaining original observedAt evidence; changed unknown baseline metadata refuses POST and preserves original.
401/403 POST durably rejected, never acknowledged;403 replay/recovery cannot dispatch another POST.
Matching and seal-only controls configure; env/profile SHA mismatch against independent mounted seal rejected. Explicit local proof fallback is nonhosted only in source.
Valid unconsumed permit reused, expired/revoked permit replaced, once consumed cannot consume twice, legacy identity-less row fails closed.
Actual operations recovery derives delivery ID/digest from server-held payroll without browser digest; optional mismatch blocked at zeroPOST.
Email reassigned to another canonical person cannot consume original approval; person-less legacy approval refused.
Authority revoked while GET acquisition resolves causes zero stages/zero SQLite sink rows after exact current principal revalidation.
Seven sequential near30second virtual request durations reconcile under240second lease. Genuine ownership expiry refuses POST.

Existing dispatch marker now stores consumed approval ID, but provably-undispatched recovery creates new dispatch after wrapper captured old row; response/audit approvalId null and audit mode incorrectly read-only.
Actual UI action function in isolated VM retains key across lost response; rotates on mapping edit/explicit restage; concurrent click blocked. DOM/browser acceptance not executed.
CircleCI proof export/tee logs and artifact store now use absolute/tmp/circleci-runtime-artifacts outside subsequent Docker context. Docker/CI run not executed.

testAdaptations: Native probe copy points to independently byte/tree-verified native-src instead of935 snapshot.
Configuration fixture supplies explicit sealed read hook matching new source contract; separate matching/seal-only/mismatch process mount tests remain.
Definitive401/403 rejection now throws as intended; test captures code and verifies actual durable rejected status, no receipt/no false acknowledgement.
Original935 test files/TAP/red observations retained unchanged.
limitations: In-process injected clients and real Node SQLite, not live provider.
TR-07 stage uses real adapter/operations/boundaries/runtimebridge and independent SQLite persistence sink; not entire integration store.
UI heldout executes actual extracted action function with controlled DOM/network collaborators, not browser/role acceptance.
TR-11 static destination checks, not executed CircleCI/Docker/context-build proof.
Root owns separate exact composition/full suites; this report does not claim their pending results, hosted/customer/deployment/recovery proof.

coordinatorAdmissionCondition.required: A transport over currently publishedb851 needs a truthful successor admission trigger delta. Preserve gate and actual remote parent; verify jobs executed rather than treating a halted-job success status as test proof.
